seoTitle: Music Cruises Manchester — Live Music on the Water
seoDescription: Music cruises in Manchester — live tribute and party nights on the Manchester Ship Canal, from ABBA and Elvis to Dolly, Adele, Club Classics, Soul River and Decks on Deck. Licensed bar onboard. Book direct.
heading: Music Cruises Manchester
intro: Tribute and party nights on the Manchester Ship Canal.

sections.heading: Manchester's floating music venue
body: Set sail for a night to remember. Our music cruises span every era and genre — from ABBA, Elvis and Dolly tributes to Adele, Club Classics, Soul River and Decks on Deck day parties — all with live entertainment, a licensed bar and unbeatable views of the waterfront after dark.
sections.note: Full line-up and descriptions — TBC from Simon (content-checklist.md).

sections.heading: Live Music Nights
body: Live tribute and themed nights — a singer, a band and a boatful of people who know every word.

sections.heading: DJ Events
body: DJ-led party cruises — anthems, floor-fillers and the city skyline as your dancefloor backdrop.

cards.name: City River Tour
cards.desc: Our signature 60-minute sightseeing cruise along the Manchester Ship Canal.

items.question: Is there a dress code?
items.answer: Come as you are or dress to impress — most guests make a night of it. (TBC)

items.question: Is there a bar onboard?
items.answer: Yes — every music cruise has a fully licensed bar. (TBC)

items.question: Are there age restrictions?
items.answer: Evening music and party nights are usually over-18s. Exact restrictions vary by event. (TBC)

items.question: Can I make a group booking?
items.answer: Absolutely — music cruises are perfect for groups and celebrations. Group details TBC.

items.question: What's included?
items.answer: Your cruise, live entertainment and access to the onboard bar (drinks not included). (TBC)
